question: Does Jinbe use the same kind of toothbrush as Luffy when he brushes his teeth? I wonder if it would be hard for him to brush his teeth if they used the same size toothbrush...
answer: Jinbe uses a scrubbing brush with a large handle to clean his teeth, but he only cleans his big teeth. He replaces his other teeth with a "pop!" sound. Being a shark, his teeth grow back easily.
name: Taro
